structured_data.title: Rear Window
structured_data.description: Professional photographer L.B. "Jeff" Jefferies breaks his leg while getting an action shot at an auto race. Confined to his New York apartment, he spends his time looking out of the rear window observing the neighbors. He begins to suspect that a man across the courtyard may have murdered his wife. Jeff enlists the help of his high society fashion-consultant girlfriend Lisa Fremont and his visiting nurse Stella to investigate.
structured_data.awards: Nominated for 4 Oscars. 7 wins & 14 nominations total

community_snippets.title: Rear Window (1954) - Metacritic reviews - IMDb
community_snippets.snippet: Simply put, Rear Window is a great film, perhaps one of the finest ever committed to celluloid. All of the elements are perfect (or nearly so), including the acting, script, camerawork, music (by Franz Waxman), and, of course, direction.
